base.role: replica footer arithmetic (Section 10.4), applied to separation footers too by Section 10.6

every_other_rule_holds: Image level is impossible: the footer's observations MUST equal the plan (Section 8.3), and every planned component has at least two records (Section 8.3). An observed count of 0 therefore always also breaks the plan-equality rule.
quotes: In a footer, the backward start delta (`0x2F8`) MUST equal the observed record count (`0x2E8`) minus one
target: backward start delta = observed record count − 1
